title: Transcontinental Realty Investors, Inc. Reports Earnings for Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
summary: DALLAS, August 06, 2026--Transcontinental Realty Investors, Inc. (NYSE:TCI) is reporting its results of operations for the three months ended June 30, 2026. For the three months ended June 30, 2026, we reported net loss attributable to common shares of $1.1 million or $0.13 per share, compared to net income $0.2 million or $0.02 per share for the same period in 2025.
